status: PROPOSAL ONLY. Nothing in the database or public/parts-catalog was changed.
purpose: A clean motocross tire list for the parts catalog (RANKED_PLAN 3.3), plus tube, mousse and TUbliss entries, to replace the adventure, trials, dual-sport, rally and enduro tires now offered on motocross bikes.
how_to_apply: On motocross models (SX, SX-F, MC, FC, TC, CRF-R, YZ, YZ-F, KX, RM-Z, 85/65/50 minis): offer only the tires below; remove the rows in drop_from_mx_bikes.
Rows in drop_from_mx_bikes marked enduro, cross-country or desert can stay on XC, XC-W, EXC, TE, FX, EX, KX-X, YZ-X and CRF-RX models.
Store position (front or rear), size and terrain as fields, not in the colour field (PARTS_AUDIT 2.3); position matters because several lines are rear-only.
Filter sizes by the bike's own stock size from verified claims (front 80/100-21; rear 100/90-19, 110/90-19 or 120/80-19 on big bikes; 85s by wheel size). 18-inch rears belong to off-road models.

Give "Mousse or tube" its own entries (below) on every bike so it never disappears for lack of listings; tighten the part-type regex in shared/part-types.ts, which today also matches "Vent Tube Cap", "Long Vent Tube" and "Twister Tube Insert".
review_before_listing rows are motocross-looking tires not researched in this pass; keep or drop after checking the maker's page.
